reason: I forget pills at home all the time and travel a lot, so a pre-counted sachet I can toss in my bag is actually useful. The launch price of $24.99 and the money-back guarantee make it a low-risk try, though I will only buy one box.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, and I already have a drawer full of half-used supplement bottles, so I worry I will quit after a week.
